widower

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Old Simon Bentley is a minister who lacks imagination. Despite being perpetually intoxicated or longing to be so, he is skilled at producing lovely prayers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)_

## History

Bentley arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as a widower and served as the town's pastor for eighteen years. Throughout his life, he remained perpetually intoxicated, or desired to be so, with his praying actually improving the more intoxicated he became. He ultimately resigned his charge in February and departed the town surrounded by the regrets of his congregation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)_
